chapter_title: The Apostle asks his Disciples: What is Cloud?
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation of the Kephalaia Chapter

---

** ¶2:** Know that what has been held capt ive shall be lib erated from the five sens ory faculties and shall rise above the whole external natural mind, and it becomes manifest and perce ivable in the rational understanding that mediates between the interior and the exterior.

**¶3:** The obsc ured state that arises from love asc ends from that love toward the interior degrees of the mind , drawn toward the form of Divine Truth in her p urity, which she presents before it . The sign of this process is the sudden illumination that breaks forth in moments of spiritual crisis . And in that illumination, the capt ive elements of wisdom are pur ified by Divine Truth, according to whatever of wisdom she makes visible . The dominant evil loves are d islodged by those sudden illuminations; they are loos ened from their hold and expelled .

**¶4:** But immediately , divine truths from the interior are summoned toward those expelled evil loves, to lay hold of them, because it is known that they can never produce anything good . Every faculty they touch they render spiritu ally dead and bring to r uin. Whenever the divine truths advance toward them and draw near, those evil loves flee in their anguish before them. They enter into whatever they first encounter and se ize upon it, as a th ief who is exposed fl ees before one stronger than himself who pursues him to take him capt ive.

**¶5:** Now, those dominant evil loves that are expelled from the obsc ured states of love and se ize upon whatever they encounter — they lay hold of whatever lies open to them, whether a perception to which they have found access , or an aff ection, or a human understanding . In short , every faculty they inhab it they consume and corrupt by the burning of their self -love. For these are evil loves, the offspring of self-love, which have now been stripped of the very ardor that sustained them.

** ¶6:** In contrast, the obscured state that arises from truth , and asc ends toward the form of Divine Truth in her purity — its sign is the res ounding power of divine truth and the rever berations that are heard in the rational mind in manif old forms. Again, there are times when the evil loves belonging to that state, which d well within the obsc urity of truth , are constrained within truth itself . And they flee from truth and abandon it.

**¶ 7:** Now, these also are such that every faculty they reach, they produce tru ths that are frozen and hard and without any warm th of charity. They destroy interior truths ready to germinate, and good works, and growing natural perceptions; and everything they reach they devast ate.

**¶8:** Again, divine truths are summoned toward them to se ize them. Yet while the divine truths pursue them in order to lay hold of them, those evil loves accomplish this destruction.

**¶9:** Also, the obscured state that ar ises from thought asc ends into the rational understanding , drawn toward the form of Divine Truth which she presents before it. Its sign is the violent intellectual force that bl ows through the mind with bitterness.

**¶10:** So, within those intellectual uph eavals, the capt ive elements of spiritual life are purified. Again, the evil loves are stripped of the obscurity of thought and desc end from it, intact in their own form . All the flowing curr ents of intelligence and the broad bodies of natural knowledge that they reach — they throw them into turb ulence and raise up confusion , and they overt urn the doc trinal systems that navigate upon them . They work destruction and seize whatever they can carry with them.

**¶11 :** Also the obscured state belonging to wisdom itself — as soon as the evil loves are stripped from it, Divine Truth receives it . She displays its sign as well . And its sign is this: you shall find it moving in peace and stillness. The elements of spiritual life within it are cleansed in peace and stillness. Again, the evil loves that are stripped from it and proceed out ward — they are met , and the divine truths se ize them.

**¶12 :** Again, the obscured state that arises from the mingled rational faculty ascends toward the form of Divine Truth. Its sign is this: that the elements of life are purified within it in still ness and rest. Those evil loves that are stripped from that obscurity and proceed from it — every faculty they find open they corrupt , until at last they too are seized and taken into their appointed con finement.

**¶13 :** The resid ues of appropri ation that those evil loves leave behind them in the various fac ulties they have reached — whether corru pted works of perception or productions of the self hood — these are gathered up and allowed to w ither. They inflict great spiritual dangers, but again, those evil loves are also sent by the divine tru ths into their con finement. The divine truths extract from them whatever of wisdom they had seized , and cast the fals ifying spirits down into the seven ou termost contain ments of the vast body of natural memory - knowledge — which is the containing form of all kn owledges that lie outside the boundary of spiritual life.

**¶15:** Those contain ments extend down ward until they reach the lowest natural states , at the very threshold of the Guardian who stands at the boundary of the mind .

**¶16:** For at appointed times these divine truths are sent to seize the evil loves. Whenever the evil loves attempt escape , the divine truths pursue them. They are given their charge . But those evil loves break free and seize upon whatever perception or self hood lies open, and are consumed in producing the offspring of the self hood — through corru pted perception and through the works of self -will . The divine truths set a watch over them, gu arding them until the hour when those evil loves are stripped of the perception and the selfhood they had assumed , and they ascend out of them . They are gathered and poured back into their original forms — the very states in which they first existed . Whatever of wisdom had remained capt ive within them is extracted . And they too are cast down into the seven outermost passages within the vast body of natural memory, the place to which those before them were cast . They reach their confinement, and the wisdom that was in them is taken.

** ¶17:** And they are cast into the ou termost prison by the divine truths , when the command is given through the power of Divine Truth in her p urity. She has authority over the entire intermediate realm, and she clean ses every element of spiritual life that is held within it.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Happen you know that it shall be released from five places and ascend over this great earth and [rise to the heights,] and it is revealed and seen in the atmosphere between.

So, the cloud shall ascend from fire to the heavens towards the likeness of the Virgin of Light that she shall display to it. Its sign is the flashes that occur with lightning storms [, and i]ts exchange [is the purifying of the lives therein]. And they shall be purified by her towards [the receiving of] the light that she shall reveal [to them]. The rulers shall be released by the lightning storms and they are freed and sent.

However, [these] angels shall immediately be summoned to them, so that they will seize them, because they know that they shall never do good. Every place they will touch they shall make dead and a loss. Whenever the angels will make towards them and come beside [them], they shall flee in their constraint before them. They go into whatever they will meet upon and assume it, like a robber being abandoned and fleeing before one stronger than him, as he runs after him to arrest him.

Now, those rulers that shall be freed from these clouds and assume whatever they will meet upon [the earth, they shall go] into the [places and the bodies] that they did not [inhabit before. They] will seize this thing, whether indeed a tree to which they have found the way, or animals, or people. Simply, every place that they will assume they shall burn and destroy by the fire of their body. Namely, the rulers, [the] children of fire, they that shall be stripped of the fire.

In contrast, [the] cloud that shall be raised up from water, and comes above towards the Virgin of Light; its sign is the thunder storms and the booms that shall come in the atmosphere in various forms and are heard. [And the lives in it shall be purified.] Again, there are times if the rulers that belong to them, which exist in the cloud, shall on occasion be constrained [in a] water [clou]d. And they flee from it and abandon it.

Now, [they] too are so, in that every place that they will [reach], they shall make frost and hail and snow. [They rui]n the seed-corn and the fruits and the plants; and they [shall devastate] every place [that] they will reach.
Again, [ang]els shall be summoned to them who seize them. Still, while the angels [ru]sh after them in order to seize them, they shall make this destruction.

Also, [the cl]oud that will be raised up from wind ascends to the atmosphere between, towards the likeness of the Virgin that she shall display to it. Its sign is [the s]torm wind that shall blow with bitterness.

So, in those winds and tempests shall the lives be purified. Again, the rulers will be stripped of the cloud of wind and they descend from it, safe in their image. All the rivers and the seas that they will reach and arrive at, they shall make waves in them and raise [up great storms,] and they [overturn] the ships. They wreak destruction [upon them,] and they seize and bring them [to the deep].

Also the cloud, the one of light, immediately they will be stripped of it [and it shall come up above towards the likeness of] the Virgin. She shall display its sign too [to it]. And its sign is this, in that you shall find it sailing in stillness and calm. The lives in it shall be cleansed in stillness and calm. Again, the rulers that will be stripped of it [and] that will come forth [from it,] they shall put [on a form,] and they take [what they shall find. But] there [straightway] the angels seize them.

Again, the cloud that shall be raised up from the mingled air comes above towards [the image] of the Virgin. Its sign is this, in that [the lives] are purified in it in stillness and [rest. And these rulers] that will be stripped of that cloud and come from it; every place that they will find [open to them,] they shall make it [dead and] one of [loss,] until [at last] they are seized and taken to their midst.

Their strippings, that they shall leave behind them in various places they will have reached, whether the produce of the trees or the offspring of the fleshes, they shall be taken midst [the things and shall] wither away. They shall inflict great dangers, but again those rulers also the angels shall send to their midst. They bring the light from them and cast the demons down to these seven outer ditches of the great sea; which is the vessel of the waters that are outside the world.
Those ditches and the [paths descend] until they reach the earths below [, at the] feet of the Porter.

for sometimes these angels shall be sent to them, to seize the rulers. Whenever the rulers [shall seek to flee and escape,] for the angels rush after them. They beseech them [, but they cannot prevail over] they that are given the command. However, [t]hose [rul]ers shall be freed from them alone and assume [the tree] and [the fle]sh. They are consumed by this offspring [of theirs, that of the] tree and that of flesh. The angels shall set a [watch] over them, that they might guard them until the hour when [those r]ulers will be stripped of tree and [flesh; a]nd they go up above. They shall be gathered [together] above, and they are poured out [and returned] in their first for[ms, the im]ages in which they first were. They take the light from them, which had remained behind in them. And they too are cast down to these seven outer [path]s that are in the great sea; the place to where these former ones [were cas]t. They shall reach their midst [and are bound,] and the light that is in them is taken.

And they are cast to the outer prison by the angels, when the command is given to them through the power of the Virgin of Light. She has authority over the entire zone, and cleanses the life that is in it.
